name: Light a fire while camping
steps: Tap pinecones on the ground to collect them.
Tap logs behind the boy to gather wood.
Tap red gas can to pour fuel.
Tap dry reeds in background to use as fuel.
Tap dead tree branch to take it.
Tap camper window to close curtains.
Tap roof luggage bag to remove it.
Tap spare tire on van to take it.
Tap blue backpack on ground to collect it.
Tap picnic blanket under van to pick it up.
